tagline: BETTER CLEANING TOOLS, ONE CLICK AWAY.

highlights.title: 30+ years of supply
highlights.body: Clean Matic highlights more than three decades of supporting consumers and business partners with consistent cleaning-equipment supply.

highlights.title: Complete cleaning range
highlights.body: The catalogue spans brooms, mops, brushes, squeegees, sponges, mats, dustpans, bins and supporting tools.

highlights.title: Retail & wholesale
highlights.body: The brand serves home users while also inviting distributors, resellers, stores and business buyers to partner.

highlights.title: Tangsel store presence
highlights.body: Clean Matic lists a store in Taman Tekno BSD, Tangerang Selatan, alongside additional retail touchpoints.
